strategy.name: SMC / ICT Liquidity Sweep + MSS + Order Block / FVG
strategy.summary: Only trade after a higher-timeframe liquidity sweep, displacement, a market structure shift, and an FVG in discount/premium.

rules.text: A higher-timeframe liquidity level was swept (PDH/PDL, Asian high/low, 1H/4H swing).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was a higher-timeframe liquidity level swept?

rules.text: Displacement: a candle with body ≥ 1.5 × ATR(14) and ≥ 70% of its range.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there a displacement candle (≥ 1.5 × ATR)?

rules.text: Market structure shift: full body close beyond the last lower-timeframe swing.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did a body close break the last swing?

rules.text: A 3-candle FVG attached to the order block.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there an FVG at the order block?

rules.text: Bullish entries below 50% of the dealing range; bearish above.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the entry in discount (longs) / premium (shorts)?

rules.text: Limit at the FVG's near edge or 50% of the FVG/OB.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you enter at the FVG edge or 50%?

rules.text: Stop 2–5 pips/ticks beyond the sweep wick.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop just beyond the sweep wick?

rules.text: If the sweep (R1) or MSS (R3) is missing, reject the trade ('inducement trap').
rules.checklistQuestion: Were both the sweep and the MSS present?
